mentions.name: IronCalc
mentions.description: An open source spreadsheet engine under development for two years, with a proof of concept available online. The project aims to deliver a fairly competent spreadsheet alternative, and the maintainers left their jobs to work on it full-time while building a community around it.
mentions.source_excerpt:
As per usual for the last two years I'm working on an open source spreadsheet engine called IronCalc. It is super exciting. We have a proof of concept at

https://app.ironcalc.com
mentions.author: nhatcher
